title_ar: الشيخ الددو يلقي كلمة الافتتاح لمخيم "التقوى" الأول باستراحة المركز
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers the Opening Address of the First "Taqwā" Camp at the Centre’s Retreat
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء صباح اليوم 12 يناير الموافق 11 ربيع الاول 1435هـ كلمة تربوية أعلن خلالها عن انطلاق أعمال المخيم الأول للمركز "مخيم التقوى" الذي يرعاه المركز تحت شعار: "اتق الله حيث ما كنت..."
وتناولت كلمة الشيخ في افتتاح المخيم إرشادات ومواعظ مؤثرة من سيّر العلماء والنبهاء في طلب العلم، وحث الطلاب على الصبر والتحلي بأخلاق العلماء وشحذ الهمم في طلب العلم..
وكان مركز تكوين العلماء قد أعلن قبل فترة عن إقامة مخيم تربوي وتكويني لصالح طلاب المركز بجميع مستوياته؛ التحضيرية والثانوية والجامعية، ويشارك في المخيم ما يناهز 200 طالب من كل مراحله التعليمية.
ويستمر المخيم لمدة أسبوع ابتداءً من 11 إلى 16 يناير 2014م الموافق من 10 إلى 15 ربيع الأول 1435هـ.
ويحشد مركز تكوين العلماء كل طواقمه التربوية والعلمية والإعلامية والتنظيمية من أجل إنجاح هذا المخيم الأول من نوعه في المركز تحت إشراف 80 مؤطرا جلهم من الطواقم التدريسية والإعلامية بالمركز.
كما يشمل هذا المخيم العنصر النسوي ممثلا في قسم العالمات بالمركز ومشاركات من الجمعيات النسوية الأخرى من خارج المركز، ويشرف عليهن مؤطرات تربويات من جمعيات نسوية أخرى.
وسيعلن في نهاية المخيم عن جوائز ومكافئات معتبرة للفائزين والفائزات في البرنامج العلمي والتربوي للمخيم.
body_en:
His eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered this morning, 12 January, corresponding to 11 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1435 AH, an address on upbringing and character in which he announced the opening of the work of the Centre's first camp, the "Taqwā Camp", which the Centre sponsors under the slogan: "Be conscious of God wherever you are…"
The Sheikh's address at the opening of the camp took up guidance and moving admonitions drawn from the lives of the scholars and of the discerning in the seeking of knowledge, and urged the students to patience, to adorning themselves with the character of the scholars, and to sharpening their resolve in seeking knowledge…
The Centre for the Formation of Scholars had announced some time before the holding of an educational and formative camp for the benefit of the Centre's students at all its levels — preparatory, secondary and university — and some 200 students from all its stages of study are taking part in the camp.
The camp runs for a week, from 11 to 16 January 2014, corresponding to 10 to 15 Rabiʿ al-Awwal 1435 AH.
The Centre for the Formation of Scholars is mobilising all its educational, scholarly, media and organisational staff in order to make a success of this camp, the first of its kind at the Centre, under the supervision of 80 supervisors, most of them from the teaching and media staff of the Centre.
This camp also takes in the women's element, represented by the Centre's section for women scholars and by participants from other women's associations outside the Centre, who are supervised by women educational supervisors from other women's associations.
At the end of the camp, substantial prizes and rewards will be announced for the winners, men and women, in the camp's scholarly and educational programme.

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11): three dates that do not agree. The body says the address was delivered 'this morning, 12 January', but also that the camp ran 11-16 January, and the CMS timestamps the record 18 January 2014, after the camp had ended. The Hijri equivalences given (12 January = 11 Rabiʿ al-Awwal, 11 January = 10 Rabiʿ al-Awwal) are also not the standard conversion for 1435. All are reproduced as found; none has been corrected. The 'today' of the body is not the date the item was published.

options: "Be conscious of God wherever you are…"
"Be mindful of God wherever you are…"
flags.note: The opening of a well-known prophetic report (al-Tirmidhi), printed by the site as a slogan with no attribution and no grading. Style guide section 4 forbids adding an attribution the source did not give, so none has been supplied. taqwā is glossed 'God-consciousness' and the verb has been rendered consistently with that, rather than as 'fear'.

flags.context: the content of the opening address
options: from the lives of the scholars and of the discerning
from the biographies of the scholars and the eminent
from the lives of the learned and the perceptive
flags.note: سيّر is the plural siyar, 'lives, biographies'. The glossary reserves sīrah for the Prophet's biography, so the English uses 'lives' here to keep the two apart. النبهاء, 'the alert, discerning, eminent', is vague in the Arabic and has been left correspondingly open.

flags.context: the CMS timestamp on the record
options: treat as the date the item was uploaded to the CMS
treat as the date of composition
flags.note: CORPUS-WIDE DEFECT. The CMS serves a bulk-upload timestamp, not the date the Sheikh spoke or wrote. date_is_cms_upload is set true. Where the body itself names a date, that internal date is the better evidence and is kept in the English.

translator_notes: An event report. The opening address itself is not in the corpus, only the site's summary of it in the site's own words.
قسم العالمات is the Centre's section for women students of religious learning; 'women scholars' renders ʿālimāt, which in this institutional context means those training as such.
مؤطر (Maghrebi usage, from the French encadreur) is a supervisor or mentor rather than a teacher.
